entries.title: Job 28:1
segments: Surely there is a mine for the silver, and a place [where] they refine gold.

entries.title: Job 28:2
segments: Iron is taken out of the earth, and bronze [is] melted [out of] the stone.

entries.title: Job 28:3
segments: He sets an end to darkness, and to every extremity He searches out the stones of darkness and the shadow of death.

entries.title: Job 28:4
segments: He opens a shaft far from the visitor; they are forgotten by [man's] foot; they hang far away from men, they swing to and fro.

entries.title: Job 28:5
segments: [As to] the earth, out of it comes bread; and underneath it is turned up like fire.

entries.title: Job 28:6
segments: Its stones [are] the place of sapphires; and it has dust of gold.

entries.title: Job 28:7
segments: [There is] a path which no bird knows, nor has the vulture's eye caught sight of it;

entries.title: Job 28:8
segments: the sons of pride have not walked on it, the lion has not passed by.

entries.title: Job 28:9
segments: He puts forth His hand on the flinty places; He overturns the mountains by the roots.

entries.title: Job 28:10
segments: He cuts out rivers among the rocks; and His eye sees every precious thing.

entries.title: Job 28:11
segments: He holds back the floods from overflowing; and the hidden thing, He brings to light.

entries.title: Job 28:12
segments: But where shall wisdom be found? And where [is] the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:13
segments: Man does not know the price of it; nor is it found in the land of the living.

entries.title: Job 28:14
segments: The deep says, [It is] not in me; and the sea says, [It is] not in me.

entries.title: Job 28:15
segments: Pure gold cannot be given in its stead, and silver be weighed as its price.

entries.title: Job 28:16
segments: It cannot be weighed against the gold of Ophir, against precious onyx, or sapphire;

entries.title: Job 28:17
segments: gold and the crystal cannot equal it, nor can it be exchanged for a vessel of fine gold.

entries.title: Job 28:18
segments: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls; and the price of wisdom [is] above rubies.

entries.title: Job 28:19
segments: The topaz of Ethiopia cannot equal it; it cannot be weighed against pure gold.

entries.title: Job 28:20
segments: From where then does wisdom come, and where [is] the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:21
segments: Yea, it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and hidden from the birds of the heavens.

entries.title: Job 28:22
segments: The place of ruin and death say, We have heard the fame of it with our ears.

entries.title: Job 28:23
segments: God understands the way of it, and He knows its place.

entries.title: Job 28:24
segments: For He looks to the end of the earth, [and] sees under all the heavens;

entries.title: Job 28:25
segments: making a weight for the winds, and measuring out the waters by measure.

entries.title: Job 28:26
segments: When He made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning to thunder;

entries.title: Job 28:27
segments: then He saw it, and declared it; He prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

entries.title: Job 28:28
segments: And to man He said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that [is] wisdom! And to depart from evil [is] understanding!
